export_rights.summary: Zoho's Terms of Service state that customers own their service data and may access it, share it via third-party integrations, and request that Zoho export or delete it. Zoho Books additionally provides admin self-serve backup of all organizational records and transactions.

routes.how: Settings > Data Backup (under Developer Space) > Backup Your Data. A download link is emailed to the registered email address; the archive contains CSV or XLS files of all records and transactions in the organization.
requires: Admin user in the Zoho Books organization
routes.rate_limits: Once a backup is initiated, another cannot be run for 15 days; backup takes roughly 30 minutes to complete.
gotchas: Download link expires 30 days after the backup date
Transaction documents/attachments are not in this backup; they are a separate 'Backup Documents' run

routes.how: Open the module's list page > More icon (top right) > Export. Optionally pick or create an export template to choose fields; option to include sensitive PII; option to password-encrypt the export file.
requires: Role with export permission for the module
gotchas: Only the first 25,000 rows can be exported per module export; beyond that, vendor docs direct you to the Data Backup feature

routes.how: REST API v3 (base documented at zoho.com/books/api/v3). OAuth 2.0: register a client in the Zoho Developer Console (api-console.zoho.com); access tokens expire after 1 hour and are renewed with the refresh token. Every request must carry the organization_id parameter (obtainable from GET /organizations).
routes.rate_limits: 100 requests/minute per organization; daily caps by plan (Free 1,000; Standard 2,000; Professional 5,000; Premium/Elite/Ultimate 10,000). HTTP 429 on breach; concurrent-call limits also enforced.
gotchas: No dedicated bulk-read/export API is documented for Zoho Books (unlike Zoho CRM's Bulk Read), so full extraction is paginated module-by-module within daily call caps

routes.how: Settings > Data Backup > Backup Documents tab > Backup Your Documents. The backup is sent to the organization's primary email address for download.
requires: Admin user in the Zoho Books organization
routes.rate_limits: Cannot run another documents backup for 15 days after one is initiated.
gotchas: Each run only includes documents added AFTER the last backup (incremental), so a first-time full dump matters; vendor community guidance says to write to support@zohobooks.com for help downloading all documents

routes.how: Reports > Activity > Audit Trail (Zoho Books logs every change to records, transactions, and settings with timestamp and user). Download via 'Export As' in the top right of the report and pick a file format.
requires: Access to the Reports module / Activity reports
gotchas: Audit-trail retention period is not documented in the consulted vendor pages

routes.how: Reports module: export individual reports via 'Export As' with configurable PDF layouts; reports can also be scheduled to auto-send by email at set frequencies (Manage Reports).
requires: Role-based access to the relevant reports

routes.how: Accountant > Chart of Accounts > More icon > Export Chart of Accounts; choose CSV, XLS, or XLSX.
gotchas: Only the chart of accounts has a documented export; custom fields, workflow rules, custom functions, and PDF templates have no documented export as restorable artifacts

preservation_notes.attachments: Settings > Data Backup > Backup Documents tab backs up transaction documents to a link emailed to the org's primary address, but each run is incremental (only documents added since the last backup) with a 15-day cooldown; vendor community guidance directs users to support@zohobooks.com for a full attachment download.
preservation_notes.audit_log: Audit Trail lives under Reports > Activity and is downloadable via 'Export As'; its retention period is not stated in the consulted vendor docs — verify in-tenant.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: Only the chart of accounts has a documented export (CSV/XLS/XLSX). No documented export of custom fields, workflow rules, custom functions, report customizations, or PDF templates as restorable artifacts — capture via screenshots/API reads in-tenant.

notes: Research caveat: direct HTTPS access to zoho.com was blocked by the research environment's egress proxy, so all vendor-page content above was gathered from search-engine renderings/summaries of the listed official Zoho pages rather than full page fetches — nav paths and limits should be re-verified in-tenant. No explicit post-termination data-retrieval window is documented; the Zoho ToS instead documents deletion timing (terminated-account data removed from the active database during a clean-up that occurs once in 6 months, and from backups ~3 months after that) and states that for inactive unpaid accounts Zoho gives prior notice and an option to back up data before deletion. Audit-trail retention is undocumented. No bulk-read API is documented for Zoho Books, so the admin Data Backup (all records as CSV/XLS) is the primary whole-account route, supplemented by the incremental Backup Documents run for attachments.
